usageNotes: Appends a new rule to the host-level firewall ruleset on the specified node; requires Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}. The node firewall must be enabled separately — adding rules here has no effect if the host firewall is disabled in the node's firewall options. Use the 'pos' parameter to insert at a specific position; omit it to append at the end.

examples.summary: Block inbound SSH from a specific external IP on the host firewall

params.comment: Block SSH brute-force from known bad IP

tips: Rules on this endpoint apply to the Proxmox host itself, not to VM/CT guest traffic — use the VM or CT firewall endpoints for guest-level rules.
The 'digest' field can be fetched from GET /nodes/{node}/firewall/rules and passed here to guard against concurrent edits.
Use 'macro' (e.g., 'SSH', 'HTTP', 'HTTPS') instead of manually specifying proto+dport for common services — macros expand to the correct protocol and port automatically.
Setting 'enable': 0 creates the rule in a disabled state, useful for staging rules before activating them.
Rules are evaluated top-down; use 'pos' to control insertion order relative to existing rules.
